_about: The legal pages as the stand-in serves them (GET /api/legal and /api/legal/<slug>). The six slugs match the footer's fixed links (lib/legal.ts LEGAL_LINKS). The wording is placeholder text for tests, not the company's real terms.

documents.title: Terms of Service
documents.summary: The agreement between you and Lodge Internet when you buy a plan.

blocks.text: Lodge Internet sells internet access codes for the hostels it serves. A code works on that hostel's network only.

items: One account belongs to one hostel.
Tell us if someone else has used your account.

blocks.text: The total shown before you pay includes every charge. You are never asked for more after that.

documents.title: Privacy Policy
documents.summary: What we collect, why, and how to have it removed.

blocks.text: Your name, email address, phone number and the hostel you choose when you register.

items: The codes we issue to you.

documents.title: Refund & Wallet Policy
documents.summary: When money comes back to you, and how your wallet works.

blocks.text: If we cannot give you a code after you pay, the money goes back to your wallet.

documents.title: Acceptable Use
documents.summary: What the network may and may not be used for.

blocks.text: Do not use the network to harm other people or other networks.

documents.title: Cookies & Storage
documents.summary: The few things this site keeps in your browser.

blocks.text: One cookie keeps you signed in. Your theme choice is kept on your device.

documents.title: Delete your data
documents.summary: How to close your account and what we must keep.

blocks.text: Open the menu, choose Delete my account, and confirm with your password.
